fassungen.unbekannt: There are no versions for this area.
fassungen.erste: First version – as it was before versions were introduced
fassungen.geloescht: The entry no longer exists – its last version is only kept as a record.
fassungen.konflikt: Someone has saved the entry in the meantime. Look at the latest version and then try again.
fassungen.schon-aktuell: This version is already the current state.
fassungen.feld-mit-werten_one: Field “{label}” is removed – one folder has a value there. The value stays stored in the folder but is no longer visible.
fassungen.feld-mit-werten_other: Field “{label}” is removed – {anzahl} folders have a value there. The values stay stored in the folders but are no longer visible.
fassungen.register-mit-dokumenten_one: Tab “{name}” is removed – it holds one document. Restoring only works once it is empty.
fassungen.register-mit-dokumenten_other: Tab “{name}” is removed – it holds {anzahl} documents. Restoring only works once it is empty.
fassungen.passen-nicht_one: One folder will no longer match the folder type (e.g. a new required field is empty). Its creator gets a to do.
fassungen.passen-nicht_other: {anzahl} folders will no longer match the folder type (e.g. a new required field is empty). Their creators get a to do.
fassungen.typ-fehlt_one: One folder type of this version no longer exists – the view only shows the others.
fassungen.typ-fehlt_other: {anzahl} folder types of this version no longer exist – the view only shows the others.
fassungen.eltern-fehlt: The view this version sat under no longer exists.
fassungen.muster-kuenftig: A different pattern only applies to future numbers; numbers already given stay as they are.
anlagen.haupt-ist-anlage: “{name}” is itself an enclosure – enclosures have no enclosures of their own.
anlagen.an-sich-selbst: A document cannot be attached to itself.
anlagen.andere-mappe: Enclosures only exist within one folder – the document is in another one.
anlagen.geloest: “{name}” is no longer an enclosure of “{haupt}” but a document of its own
anlagen.reihenfolge: The order must list exactly the enclosures of the document, each once.
anlagen.positionen: anlagen: a list of positions in seiten where an enclosure begins – never at the start of a part.
anlagen.ohne-recht: A package may only create enclosures when splitting with the right dms:anlagen.
anlagen.nur-post-teilen: Enclosures are only created when splitting post.
anlagen.allein: “{name}” is an enclosure and only goes with its main document – choose the main document or make it a document of its own first.
anlagen.nur-pakete-mit-recht: A package may only change enclosures with the right dms:anlagen and only in post.
anlagen.post-mit-anlagen_one: Split from “{betreff}”: document with one enclosure
